meta.description:
**Soil Water Index (SWI), daily**

Global soil moisture from 0% (completely dry) to 100% (fully saturated), at 0.1° (about 12.5 km) resolution. Derived from Metop ASCAT surface soil moisture and updated daily.

Layer shown: SWI001 (characteristic time length T = 1 day).

attribution.text: Soil Water Index: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service, derived from Metop ASCAT surface soil moisture (EUMETSAT H SAF). Served via DestinE EDEN

sources.name: EDEN DTEH – Soil Water Index (10-Day Composite)

meta.description: The dataset tracks soil moisture anomalies and surface water dynamics across Europe. Developed by TU Wien under the European Commission's DestinE initiative, it feeds directly into the Weather-Induced Extremes Digital Twin. It uses an exponential filter to turn surface soil moisture retrievals, mainly from ASCAT and Sentinel-1 radar, into estimates of moisture deeper in the soil.

attribution.text: Soil Water Index: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service, derived from Metop ASCAT surface soil moisture (EUMETSAT H SAF). Served via DestinE EDEN

meta.description:
**Cumulative fire carbon emissions by country**

Year-to-date emissions from landscape fires for each country, 2001–2026, from the Global Fire Emissions Database (GFED). Click a country to compare the current year (highlighted) with earlier years.

Unit: megatonnes of carbon (Mt C). Multiply by 3.67 to convert to CO₂. Data from 2023 onward are provisional (beta).

meta.description:
**CLMS Burnt Area 300 m: fraction of burned area (V4, derived-monthly)**

Fraction (‰) of each 300 m pixel affected by fire during the month, from Sentinel-3 data. Monthly product computed from the daily near-real-time product using pixel with the highest scoring probability of burn. Use the time control to step from January 2025 to October 2026.

attribution.text: Burnt Area 300 m, version 4: generated by the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service, based on Copernicus Sentinel-3 data

sources.name: CLMS Burnt Area (BA) Global 300m V4 MONTHLY - DAY OF BURN

meta.description:
**CLMS Burnt Area 300 m: day of burn (V4, monthly)**

Day of the year (1–366) on which burning was detected in each 300 m pixel, from Sentinel-3 data. Monthly product computed from the daily near-real-time product. Use the time control to step from January 2025 to October 2026.

**Soil moisture anomaly comparison: October 2025 (left) vs 2026 (right)**

Monthly surface soil moisture anomaly (m³ m⁻³) relative to the 1991–2020 monthly climatology. Positive values mean wetter than normal, negative values drier. Drag the divider to compare the two years.

Source: C3S satellite surface soil moisture, combined product (v202505).
